result.summary: Found 1 visually broken issue: overlapping, unreadable metadata text under Tokumaru Ramen Bar; other partially visible carousel and bottom content is intentional scrolling behavior.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' in the 'Popular right now' section, the metadata line is garbled with overlapping text. Characters in the delivery time / delivery info area (around '25-30 min delivery') are rendered on top of each other, making the line unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Remove the duplicate/overlapping text layer, ensure only one metadata string is rendered on a single line (e.g. '25-30 min · Ramen'), and check constraints/auto-layout so the time, delivery info, and cuisine labels do not overlap.
